title: Introducing Digi EX61: Rugged, Indoor/Outdoor 5G Connectivity with 10X Faster Failover
summary: Meet Digi EX61, a PoE-powered 5G extender with multi-carrier eSIM, DSDS failover and an IP66 enclosure. Capture strong signal indoors or outdoors.
